note: Second and later conversations with N: one line that acknowledges the room, then her standing offer. Deliberately short — she is not a hint dispenser. Same flag as her first scene, which is what makes it idempotent.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: 她又从讲台上抬起头：还是那个眼神，先看人，再看手上那张卷子。

nodes.speaker: n
nodes.text: 我会待在这里改卷子。有问题的话……可以来问我。
